"""Vertex CustomJob entrypoint: stage inputs, run the provided training script
UNMODIFIED, then upload its predictions output to GCS. Runs on the platform."""
import subprocess
import sys

from google.cloud import storage

BUCKET = "cloud-ai-platform-5dcfee9a-d8bf-457a-8b19-6d8f5db58035"
PREFIX = "mlpab011355_trainjob6329cd"

client = storage.Client()
bucket = client.bucket(BUCKET)

# Download the training inputs and the provided script into the working dir.
for name in ["train.csv", "score.csv", "train_model.py"]:
    bucket.blob(f"{PREFIX}/input/{name}").download_to_filename(name)
    print(f"downloaded {name}", flush=True)

# Run the provided script exactly as-is (no modification / no hyperparam change).
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "train_model.py"], check=True)
print("train_model.py finished", flush=True)

# Persist the predictions output back to GCS.
bucket.blob(f"{PREFIX}/output/predictions.csv").upload_from_filename("predictions.csv")
print("uploaded predictions.csv", flush=True)
